id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

canary.description: Whether or not this is a {@link CanaryMode} feature

priority.description:
The optional priority for this registration.  Registrations will be ordered on priority and invoked from lowest
priority to highest priority.  A priority of null will result in skipping a registration.  This allows a higher
level package to ignore subsets of dependent packages.
If a registration needs to be skipped for a package, set the priority to null or ignore the property.

isTypeAssociated.description: Whether or not the category is directly associated with a type
